source: NASA AE8/AP8 trapped radiation models (NSSDC; Vette 1991, Sawyer & Vette 1976), evaluated with radbelt (NASA GSFC, NOSA 1.3) on a node grid
units: omnidirectional integral flux above E, particles cm^-2 s^-1
encoding: per (energy, L): cut = round(10000*log10(cutoff B/B0)), 0 = no trapped flux; row = round(100*log10(flux)) at u nodes, u = log(B/B0)/log(cutoff)
